title: Cylindrical base
spec: Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero degrees and a translation vector also set to zero. Draw a two-dimensional sketch on the first face, and within this face, draw a single loop. Inside this loop, draw a circle with its center at coordinates [0.0141, 0.0141] and a radius of 0.0141 units. Apply a scaling factor of 0.0281 to the entire two-dimensional sketch to adjust its size. Rotate the two-dimensional sketch plane using Euler angles of [0.0, 0.0, 0.0] and translate it using the translation vector [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]. Extrude the scaled two-dimensional sketch along the normal direction by 0.75 units to generate a three-dimensional model. Ensure that the extrusion does not occur in the opposite direction, resulting in a new solid body. The final dimensions of the cylindrical base will be 0.028125 units in length, 0.028125 units in width, and 0.75 units in height.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create a circle in the sketch
r = r.center(0.0141, 0.0141).circle(0.0141)

# Extrude the circle to create a cylinder
r = r.extrude(0.75)

# Scale the sketch (this step is not necessary as the scale is applied to the sketch before extrusion)
# r = r.scale(0.0281)

# The final model is represented as 'r'

lanes.label: Cadabra 4B (ours) · best of 8
lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Define the initial coordinate system
workplane = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create the sketch for the base of the cylinder
sketch = (
    workplane
    .center(0.0141, 0.0141)  # Move to the center of the circle
    .circle(0.0141)  # Draw a circle with the specified radius
)

# Extrude the sketch to create the cylinder
cylinder = sketch.extrude(0.75)

# Assign the final model to 'r'
r = cylinder

import cadquery as cq

# Create a cylinder along the Z axis
# Outer diameter: 0.0282 (radius 0.0141), height: 0.7500
outer_radius = 0.0282 / 2.0
height = 0.7500

r = cq.Workplane("XY").circle(outer_radius).extrude(height)

lanes.label: Kimi K3 (high)
lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Create the base cylinder
r = cq.Workplane("XY").circle(0.0141).extrude(0.75)

# Create the inner cylinder to make it hollow
inner = cq.Workplane("XY").circle(0.0105).extrude(0.75)

# Subtract the inner cylinder from the base cylinder to create a hollow tube
r = r.cut(inner)
